question.reasoning: The proposer's description promises to add Ravi (0x2C81904f370e7f6490aEa328CA847AEFdc3853D3) as an owner and keep the signature threshold at 2. While the transaction does add Ravi and initially sets the threshold to 2, it also executes an additional step that lowers the Safe's signature threshold from 2 to 1. This directly contradicts the explicit promise to keep the threshold at 2.
question.statement: This transaction was refused because it contradicts the description regarding the Safe's approval threshold. While it adds Ravi (0x2C81904f370e7f6490aEa328CA847AEFdc3853D3) as a fourth owner as promised, it also lowers the required signature threshold from 2 to 1 instead of keeping it at 2. Executing this would allow any single owner to unilaterally execute transactions from the Safe.
